description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source project and implements a web page that displays a list of requirements with optional custom field data in an ExtJS table. It includes logic for retrieving requirements, handling user input, generating a data table with various requirement attributes, and integrating with ExtJS for presentation.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class used to generate ExtJS tables with grouping, sorting, and toolbar features for presenting requirement data.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes user input parameters, such as selected test project and requirement overview options.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Initializes GUI data structure with page title and messages based on user input.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Loads configuration settings for the application, such as URL separators, charset, and date/time formats.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions to access requirement data and restricts access if necessary.
